text:
pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT triggered: High 5xx error rate observed at api-gateway (edge). 502/504 spike starting ~1778882160. Current error rate 14%. Link: https://telemetry.redwood.internal/alerts/1778882222 :rotating_light:

alex: taking this, paging oncall. I'll be primary until handoff.

jamie: I'm on comms, will gather customer impact and slack updates.

priya: seeing same in eu-west-1 and us-east-1, eu is worse (~22% 502s). Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/apigw/latency?from=now-1h

ops-sre: quick data point from edge logs: surge correlates with increased POST /v1/generate traffic to model-proxy-backend-3. 5xx patterns look like upstream timeouts + gateway fanout failures.

alex: thanks. @deploy-bot any deploys in last 20m?

deploy-bot: Deployment event: service=model-router, user=ci-bot, sha=ab12f4, env=prod, started=1778882100, finished=1778882115. No rollback currently.

jamie: customer-impact: multiple active customers report generation failures, trial bots timing out, marketing sites show API errors for background tasks. Escalating to support to open a banner if we don't drop below 5% in 15m.

priya: running a quick tcpdump on gw host gw-12. seeing lots of RST from backend pool 10.5.2.* after ~30s. suspect connection limits on model-proxy-backend-3.

alex: plan: 1) enable per-backend circuit breaker (short window) 2) remove model-proxy-backend-3 from routing pool 3) apply request-level rate limit for POST /v1/generate 4) roll forward if mitigation fails. Implementing now.

ops-sre: concur. add a temporary global 429 throttle at edge for suspect path. Prefer granular 5s token-bucket at gw.

jamie: executing customer comms draft: "We're investigating elevated API errors; working to restore service. We'll update in 15 min." Anyone object?

alex: go ahead. jamie publish when we have mitigation in place.

priya: removing backend from pool: 

```
# on controller
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://controlplane.redwood.internal/pools/model-proxy/remove \
  -d '{"instance":"model-proxy-backend-3"}'
```

priya: confirmed drain signal sent, connections draining. healthcheck for backend-3 failing (502/timeout).

ops-sre: enabling circuit breaker rule: 

```
# applied rule
- resource: /v1/generate
- threshold: 50 errors / 1m
- action: short-circuit 503 for 5s, increment backoff
```

ops-sre: push done. also set a temporary per-IP rate limit: 100 rps.

alex: adding an extra routing weight to region fallback (us-west-2) to absorb some traffic: 

```
# routing patch
PATCH /routes/primary
body: {"weights": {"us-west-2": 0.25, "us-east-1": 0.6, "eu-west-1": 0.15}}
```

jamie: monitoring: error rate dropped from 14% -> 6.8% within 60s. latency tail still high. customers still affected but far fewer. posting update to status page now.

jamie: status update posted: "Mitigations applied (circuit breakers, backend removed, routing adjustments). Error rate improving; monitoring continues. Expected next update in 15 minutes."

alex: digging into backend logs on model-proxy-backend-1/2: seeing long GC pauses and thread pool exhaustion around 1778882080-1778882120. GC triggered by large batched requests from a single internal job.

priya: can we throttle internal batch job and apply header-based priority? Which job? job-id=ingest-bulk-4392 from batcher service.

ops-sre: yes. Add ingress rule to downgrade requests with X-Internal-Job: ingest-bulk-* to low priority/queue. Applying now.

alex: applied: 

```
# ingress filter
if header X-Internal-Job =~ "ingest-bulk-" then set header X-Priority=low; rate-limit 20rps
```

alex: after header throttling, GC events drop, backend queue clears. error rate now 1.5% global. eu-west trending down to 3%.

jamie: customer comms update: "Errors reduced significantly; full recovery expected within 30 minutes. Engineering in mitigation mode."

priya: small regression observed: a subset of requests still 504 from model-proxy-backend-2 for long sequences. Increasing model-proxy timeout from 30s -> 45s as temporary measure.

ops-sre: change applied. watch for token leakage.

jamie: monitoring: 5xx now ~0.8%, latency p95 returning to normal. no new alerts for 5m.

alex: preparing handoff: I'll move to post-incident analysis. @ops-sre please own the warmfixes (timeouts, rate-limits) for next 2 hours. @priya please run a postmortem data capture (logs, heapdumps from backends) and coordinate with model infra.

ops-sre: ack. will keep the circuit breaker rules until we confirm backend stability.

priya: capturing heapdumps and making tickets: PM-1234 backend GC root cause, INFRA-987 routing weight safety. attaching logs to the ticket.

jamie: final customer update posted and support notified to close active tickets once customers confirm.

pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT status: mitigation successful, error rate reduced. Incident routed to SEV3 monitoring phase.

alex: closing thread for realtime ops. We'll open a postmortem thread with timeline + RCA doc in ~24h. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
